inputs.streetplan_bin: mod/src/main/resources/skycraft/baked/streetplan.bin (version 1, 884 settlements, 60153 nodes, 57709 edges, 12936 doors, 63807 plots, 64549 specs)
inputs.world_sample: mod/run/world (saved QA world with whiterun, helgen and 5 farms generated), used for world_truth only
inputs.places: mod/src/main/resources/skycraft/tamriel/places/*.json; tier from the place type (place type capital in skyrim_settlements counts as capital only for the five hold capitals)

definitions.key_buildings.status: reachable = a door cell of the building is connected to a gate over the plan walk raster (street/lane/alley bands, bridges, stairs edges, plaza rectangles, gate passages, doorstep paths; 8-neighbour, height step <= 1, <= 2 on stairs cells); street_only = the planner found a street for the door (StreetPlan dReach true) but that street is not connected to any gate; unreachable = no walk; no_door = the builder declares no entrance (Canvas.door instead of Canvas.entrance: jails, some landmarks), so the plan cannot test it
definitions.gates: nodes of class GATE (a planned road end within 16 blocks of the predicted gate); road_join nodes seed the walk when a settlement has no GATE node
definitions.tier_connection.levels: building floors (y of the floor block) with >= 2 enterable buildings: how many have a door connected to a gate
definitions.props_on_street: non-OMIT YARD/LAMP/WELL/STALL specs whose footprint overlaps a street/lane/alley/path band outside plazas
definitions.scatter_in_core: non-OMIT FIELD/GARDEN/PEN/HOMESTEAD_PLOT specs within 0.4-0.6 x reach of the centre with >= 4 buildings within 20 blocks
definitions.house_repeats: houses = HOVEL/COTTAGE/HOUSE/TOWNHOUSE/FARMHOUSE specs; footprints by WxD; small = footprint <= 63 cells (7x9)
definitions.areas_by_class: footprint and first-floor interior cells ((w-2)*(d-2), before annex/porch/stair strip); n = buildings of the class
definitions.free_space: cells inside 0.85 x reach: occupied (buildings + 1 margin, walls, streets, plazas), soft_works (gardens, pens, fields, props, camps: reclaimable), free; fit.<class>.free/reclaim = a lot of that size (+1 margin) fits with a street within 3 blocks; terrain slope and water are not in the plan, so fits are optimistic
definitions.npc_jobs.status: ok | missing_anchor (no building of the settlement provides the role) | anchor_present_no_work_routine (HOUSECARL/STEWARD/WIZARD: Schedule has no WORK branch for them) | anchor_present_standing_only (JARL: stands near the throne block, no seat) | anchor_present_unreachable_from_gate | posted_by_guardwatch

tier_floors_4_4.note: DESIGN-PRINCIPLES 4.4 (WORLD-PLAN only cites it). The repo holds no Skyrim footprint or interior-area medians; size_targets are proposals.

size_targets.note: proposed minimum lot (w x d, with porch and annex) per tier, to be confirmed by the owner; an interior must hold a counter, staff and 6 customers (shops) or common room + bar + 4 rooms (inns)

whiterun.method: flood fill over the generated blocks of the saved QA world (mod/run/world, 2026-10-13 18:45), walkable=solid floor with 2 passable cells above, step up<=1, down<=3, start=gate cells

plan_vs_world.note: the planned main street ramps 120->127 over z -46..-68 (edges 845-857); the built street is flat 120 until z=-64, 121 at z=-65, then a 6 block wall (terrace edge at z=-67, one stair block at z=-66 y=127)

upper_tier_entrances.main_street_x62: cliff 121->127 at z -65/-66, one stair block (cobblestone_stairs y127 z-66) then nothing
upper_tier_entrances.east_alley_x130_138_z76: plan has a STAIRS edge (138,-76,120)->(130,-76,126) (edge 988); built: grass 120 at x=137, stone_bricks 127 at x=136, 7 block wall, no stairs

doorstep_problems.problem: back door opens onto a backyard garden fence (spruce_fence y121 at x104..107,z-9, crops behind it); no standable doorstep cell
west door opens onto a garden fence (spruce_fence at x-29..-27,z-71, beetroots/cabbages behind); no standable doorstep cell

shrine_candle_bug.blocks: y120 grass, y121 candle(3,lit), y122 skycraft:shrine_of_kynareth (lectern fallback)
y120 grass, y121 candle, y122 skycraft:shrine_of_kynareth

helgen.method: flood fill over the generated blocks of the saved QA world (mod/run/world, 2026-10-13 18:45), walkable=solid floor with 2 passable cells above, step up<=1, down<=3, start=gate cells
